agent_note: Extremely low event-narration yield: 1 of 22 quotes. Page is dominated by advice-speech and aphorism, which is the adversarial bias METHODOLOGY warns about. Quotation marks survive on only 2 quotes (q08349, q08365), so dialogue was assigned via vocatives, direct address, speech markers, and register; the boundary I used was that generic-'you' maxims with no story-world referent go to gnomic while direct address referencing specific story facts goes to dialogue. Retrospective read rests on a single narration quote (q08352, past, third person) with zero present-tense narration anywhere; evidence is thin and insufficient for a book label.
